steps.q: Does it make a great product or service?
Will it keep earning above market profits?

views.text: In July 2024, Equity Mates described Occidental Petroleum’s prime Permian Basin acreage as enabling low-cost production, noting that access to highly productive land created a cost advantage competitors could not easily match.

episode.title: We're searching for the world's best moat, 1 million people working for you & Pimp my Portfolio

views.text: In May 2023, Equity Mates noted that, despite questions about the Permian potentially peaking, Berkshire still liked Occidental’s position while acknowledging oil prices were unpredictable and shifts in the basin could quickly change US output.

steps.q: Can it reinvest its profits productively?

views.text: In May 2023, Equity Mates said Occidental had been retiring part of Berkshire’s US$10 billion preferred stake, which Berkshire viewed as intelligent from Occidental’s standpoint, highlighting management’s capital structure decisions after the oil market collapse reversed.

steps.q: Can it be bought at a reasonable price?
